info.title: Multicast_Operational_Static_Nexthop
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Operational_Static_Nexthop](#/Multicast_Operational_Static_Nexthop)
The outgoing list of [Multicast_Operational_Static_Nexthop] (Multicast_Operational_Static_Nexthop)s associated with this route entry.

forwarded_tunnel_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Tunnel_Endpoint](#/Tunnel_Endpoint)
[Tunnel](#/Tunnel_Endpoint) entries to which traffic would be forwarded. This is only applicable for L3VNI interfaces and not SVIs.

l3_vni.description:
Reference Resource: [Virtual_Network_ID](#/Virtual_Network_ID)
Downstream L3 Virtual Network Identifier on which the source stream is forwarded or pruned.

ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The downstream [Port](#/Port) on which the source stream is forwarded.

parameters.name: Multicast_Operational_Static_Route.port
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Operational_Static_Route](#/Multicast_Operational_Static_Route)
The upstream [Port](#/Port) on which the source stream is received.

parameters.name: Multicast_Operational_Static_Route.source_address
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Operational_Static_Route](#/Multicast_Operational_Static_Route)
The Source Address of the stream. This includes wildcard entry 'any' for (*, G) entries.

parameters.name: Multicast_Operational_Static_Route.group_address
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Operational_Static_Route](#/Multicast_Operational_Static_Route)
The Group Address of the stream.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
